acs.text_first_line: AC1 The NLEADS result is written on the treatment and the state moves to APPROVED
AC2 A refusal is recorded with its reason and the state moves to REFUSED
AC3 The write is refused when a value is missing, malformed or out of range
AC4 A treatment that already carries a result, or is not submitted, is refused
AC5 Two officers record at once
AC6 A failed record write leaves the treatment unchanged
AC7 The read carries the recorded outcome to the pack and to SCR-14
AC8 The recorded level is stored as given and the required level is not judged here
AC9 No personal data, no ACE view and no cross-schema read

ops_provided: GET /api/recovery/treatment/v1/treatments/{treatmentId} with nleadsRef (DF-TRT-023), creditResult (DF-TRT-024), approvalLevel (DF-TRT-011), creditResultAt (DF-TRT-026), the state, the version and the plan terms (API-S2-002 shape of RWB-S2-E3001-CON); right Treatment and offer R

PATCH /api/recovery/treatment/v1/treatments/{treatmentId} in its credit-result variant (nleadsRef, result, approvalLevel, resultDate, reason) with the If-Match header on the treatment version (API-S2-003 shape of RWB-S2-E3002-CON); right Treatment and offer U; element names Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2689; ASM-4437)
